keyword.title: Keyword
keyword.description: Free-text search, same as the Grants.gov search box. Leave empty to list every opportunity matching the other filters.

agencies.title: Agency codes
agencies.description: Optional Grants.gov agency codes, e.g. HHS, USDA-NIFA, DOC-EDA, DOE. Sub-agency codes are accepted.

fundingCategories.title: Funding category codes
fundingCategories.description: Optional category codes, e.g. AG (Agriculture), ED (Education), EN (Energy), HL (Health), ST (Science & Technology), CD (Community Development), IS (Information & Statistics).

eligibilities.title: Eligibility codes
eligibilities.description: Optional applicant eligibility codes, e.g. 00 (State governments), 01 (County), 02 (City/township), 06 (Public higher ed), 12 (Nonprofits with 501c3), 22 (For-profit other than small business), 23 (Small businesses), 25 (Others).

fundingInstruments.title: Funding instrument codes
fundingInstruments.description: Optional: G (Grant), CA (Cooperative Agreement), PC (Procurement Contract), O (Other).

postedAfter.title: Posted on or after
postedAfter.description: Optional ISO date (YYYY-MM-DD). Opportunities opened before this date are skipped.

closesAfter.title: Closes on or after
closesAfter.description: Optional ISO date (YYYY-MM-DD). Skip opportunities whose close date is before this date. Useful to drop deadlines that already passed.

maxResults.title: Maximum opportunities
maxResults.description: Stop after this many opportunities. Each opportunity is one charged result.

includeDetails.title: Fetch full details
includeDetails.description: Fetch the full synopsis for every opportunity (description, eligibility text, award ceiling/floor, number of awards, cost sharing, contact, attachments). Turn off for a faster list-only run with the same per-result price.

includeDescriptionHtml.title: Include description as HTML
includeDescriptionHtml.description: Also include the raw HTML synopsis in addition to the plain-text version.
